h: The Ancestral Inheritance Brings Hope After the Spies

p: After the parshah of the spies
comes the parshah of the libations,
"When you come into the land of your dwellings."
And in the Midrash Rabbah on this parshah (Bamidbar Rabbah 17):
you call it the land of Canaan,
and here 'the land of your dwellings.'
HaKadosh Baruch Hu said to them:
to Avraham, to Yitzchak and to Yaakov…" and so on,
is it called "the land of your dwellings,"
because it is held by inheritance from the Avos?
that the Ramban, of blessed memory, on this parshah
to console them and reassure them,
at the end of forty years?"
"And the Ark of the covenant of Hashem journeyed before them
to seek out a resting place for them."
And we said that it was to refine them
of which the Avos are the chariot,
and which stand against the three kelipos,
"to seek out a resting place for them":
that they would enter Eretz Yisrael immediately.
in all the three kelipos mentioned,
at Taverah and at Kivros HaTa'avah
(as we have spoken of this several times).
And afterward they sent the spies
to scout the land of Canaan,
which was also with this intent,
as explained in the previous maamar.
But the spies did not repair;
What will be at the end of forty years?
Perhaps they will go further astray,
and then they will not be able to enter.
And therefore it was said to them,
"When you come into the land of your dwellings."
Eretz Yisrael is held in our hands
and it will be in the merit of the Avos,
at the end of forty years (Devarim 9:5):
but because of the wickedness of the nations…
and in order to fulfill the word
that Hashem swore to your fathers…"
But at the time the spies were sent,
their measure was not yet filled,
כִּי לֹא שָׁלֵם עֲוֹן הָאֱמוֹרִי עַד הֵנָּה
"For the iniquity of the Emori is not yet complete."
they would have entered in their own merit;
and this they did not achieve.
But for the end of forty years
they were promised that they would merit it,
And this is the matter of what is said about Shabbos
"'Dwelling,' which the Torah wrote regarding Shabbos
for there are seventy faces to the Torah,
has seventy faces to the Torah
the holiness of the three Avos,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (זֹהַר חֵלֶק ב רד, א)
the Daughter crowned with the Avos";
that Eretz Yisrael is held in our hands
And it is written, "in all your dwellings,"
עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁאָמְרוּ (שַׁבָּת קיח, א)
נוֹתְנִין לוֹ נַחֲלָה בְּלֹא מְצָרִים כּוּ׳
is given an inheritance without boundaries…
like Yaakov, of whom it is written (Bereishis 28:14):
'And you shall spread out westward and eastward…'"
the keeping of Shabbos…" and so on,
Therefore on Shabbos the Jew merits
And this is what it says,
which is an inheritance from the Avos.
